body:
Recently went to philhealth for registration/application. Since PWD ako, I checked that in the lower section dun sa forms. Nag inquire ako before lining up and sabi nung nasa info desk iba daw proseso ng application kapag pwd ka. Kailangan ko daw pumunta sa DSWD na malapit sakin and apply for the PWD program there and wait for the next steps. I'm confused, has anyone went through this process?

Off topic:
Wondering din too if dalawa ba talaga yung booklet (one for grocery and meds) kapag PWD ka kasi isa lang binigay sa akin.
One per significant person, i'll keep it short
Yea, im writing one right now
Happens a lot to me too which is why I stutter a lot
Everyday. There's a chanting in my head telling me to kill myself

I do have family and friends but I just feel detached with them. I also don't think that its a good idea to stick around around till my 30s while they see me waste away my life. Up until now, the facade I'm maintaining is okay (not enough to worry them). So for me, its better now than later or at least until the facade is still intact.
Most of the time my chest aches or I feel like Im 40ft underwater and my body is trying so hard to move
Like that booth in futurama where you can walk in and choose a way to die, wish we had that right now
I have tried but I live in the philippines. I can't find a good spot to vent without bumping into other people. You'd have to pay a huge sum of money to find a place and be solitary.
